legacy.description: Arrival-profile fixtures for Perplexity, Fireworks AI, Pinecone (current pcsk_ and context-gated legacy UUID keys), Slack user tokens and GitLab runner authentication tokens. These families have no product detector contract of their own; the corpus measures and records, and moves no support status.
